source.name: RoboLibrary — Cameraman Tower Defense Units, section 'Crate Odds Behind These Units'

spider.name: Spider Crate
spider.odds: 90% Speaker Spider, 9.8% Camera Spider, 0.2% TV Spider

basic.name: Basic Crate
basic.odds: Basic, uncommon and rare pulls make up roughly 95%; one slot is shared at 1-in-1,000
basic.note: Rotates its featured units every 20 minutes, so summoning while the unit you want is showing is a real lever.

woman.name: Woman Crate
woman.odds: Drops 10% of the time on Insane and 2% on Easy

mythic.name: Mythic Crate
mythic.cost: 900 coins per summon, 8,100 for a ten-pull
mythic.odds: Published pool tables disagree with each other, so only the Godly rate is reproduced here.
mythic.note: Two community readings both put Upgraded Titan TV Man at 0.1%; one separately lists a 0.01% chance from the Basic Crate that the other does not corroborate.

tv-spider.extra: That works out to roughly one TV Spider per 500 summons at 100 gems each.

upgraded-titan-tv-man.extra: At 0.1% with discounted ten-pulls, the average cost of one copy is roughly 810,000 coins. A 2.5x luck boost lifts the displayed rate to about 0.3%.
